# About Me

I am Khatun A Jannat, an MSc student in Computer Science and Engineering with a major in Data Science at Daffodil International University, Bangladesh.

My academic interests include Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Explainable AI, Data Analytics, and Cloud Computing.

I am currently conducting research on ADHD prediction using Explainable Deep Learning techniques and behavioral data analysis.

## Welcome to my personal homepage

I am Khatun A Jannat, an MSc student in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) at Daffodil International University.

My research interests include Machine Learning, Explainable AI, Healthcare Analytics, and Data-Driven Intelligent Systems.

I am interested in developing AI-based solutions that create social, environmental, and economic impact.
